Use twoPhaseEulerFoam to simulate steady-state, isothermal, incompressible oil-water flow in a horizontal pipe.
Set the pipe diameter to 0.1 m and the pipe length to 5 m.
Set the fixed mixture velocity at the inlet to 1 m/s.
At the inlet, set both phase velocities to 1 m/s and set alpha.water to 0.3.
Apply noSlip boundary conditions to both phases on the pipe walls.
In 0/alpha.water, set the outlet boundary condition to zeroGradient.
Set the outlet pressure p_rgh to fixedValue with uniform 0.
Use water density 1000 kg/m3 and oil density 800 kg/m3.
Use water kinematic viscosity 1e-6 m2/s and oil kinematic viscosity 1e-5 m2/s.
Run the simulation until the flow field reaches a steady state.
